subject.title: Add Model and Token Usage Status Display to Control UI Topbar

question: Should the Control UI add a persistent topbar model/token/quota status, or should Chat, Sidebar, Usage, Debug, /status, and /usage remain the supported placements?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the topbar density, status meaning, freshness semantics, and whether token usage means context usage or provider quota require maintainer product/UX intent before implementation.

options.title: Define a compact topbar contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify which canonical session/model/provider-usage fields may appear in the topbar, including stale and unavailable states.

options.title: Decline topbar placement
options.body: Close after maintainer decision and point users to Chat controls, Sidebar quota, Usage, Debug, /status, and /usage as the supported surfaces.

options.title: Split chat quota from topbar model status
options.body: Route provider-specific quota widget work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167 and keep this issue focused on topbar active-model placement only.

recommendation.title: Define a compact topbar contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify which canonical session/model/provider-usage fields may appear in the topbar, including stale and unavailable states.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Control UI placement decision, and steipete has recent adjacent shell history plus prior review context on this issue.
